dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Already became dust in the wind, the Yajna Grass. Nara probably see it that way.

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: But... It is radiant again from the forest plants, those already floated away, deeply buried, memories of green leaves with no trace... Every time new Yajna Grass grows new sprouts.

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} and White Floaty are the same. New friends, also old friends. Because have withered and are reborn.
